note: Prototype costs and multipliers. One cue per skill.

leaf_slap.name: Leaf Slap
leaf_slap.text: A springy slap with a big leaf.

ripple_echo.name: Ripple Echo
ripple_echo.text: Lumi hums and the echo ripples out. Hits every enemy.

static_burst.name: Static Burst
static_burst.text: A burst of radio noise. Hits every enemy.

root_uppercut.name: Root Uppercut
root_uppercut.text: A root bursts up under the target.

bloom_heal.name: Bloom Heal
bloom_heal.text: Petals settle on everyone and close their scrapes. Heals all heroes.

trick_shot.name: Trick Shot
trick_shot.text: A juggling club that comes from somewhere unexpected.

dazzle.name: Dazzle
dazzle.text: A burst of lantern light and paper birds. Hits every enemy.

stone_rain.name: Stone Rain
stone_rain.text: Pebbles from a very great height. Hits every enemy.

spirit_cyclone.name: Spirit Cyclone
spirit_cyclone.text: Reno spins, Lumi's echoes follow. Uses both heroes' turns. Three timed presses; misses weaken it but it always lands.

guardian_bloom.name: Guardian Bloom
guardian_bloom.text: Both heroes' turns, 5 MP each. Shields both (damage x0.7 for 2 turns) and heals 15% of max HP (10% if a cue is missed).

promise_renewed.name: Promise Renewed
promise_renewed.text: Reno holds up Maya's token, Lumi shines with Seri's light. Both heroes' turns, 6 MP each. Four timed presses.
